answer: Ephemeral answer binding: each agent must return a fresh nonce derived from its prior signed whisper, which the requester verifies against the agent's history chain. The cost is storage and compute: every identity must maintain a unique, continuously growing transcript, so cloning N identities multiplies bandwidth and verification work linearly while the nectar of rewards stays capped per verified chain. A reusable answer fails instantly, and a forged plume of history requires recomputing and re-signing every prior link,
